author: wei
text: :rotating_light: INC-2291 (Sev2) declared. Duplicate usage events for the repeated 1–2 AM hour on Nov 1 (DST fallback). Consumer keys hourly buckets on local time, so the hour was written twice. IC: Wei. Comms: Aisha.

author: mateo
text: Raw events confirm: 41 workspaces affected, all in US timezones. Double-counted volume is about 6.1% of Nov 1 total usage for those workspaces.

author: ethan
text: Billing impact: October invoices closed Oct 31 so they're clean. November invoices would include the duplicates if we don't fix before Dec 1.

author: lucas
text: I can freeze the Nov 1 aggregates in billing until the backfill lands.

author: wei
text: Plan: (1) dedupe key on (workspace, event_id) instead of (workspace, local_hour), (2) re-run Nov 1 backfill, (3) Lucas recomputes billing aggregates. ETA Wednesday.

author: aisha
text: Customer comms: 'We found and are fixing a display issue that double-counted one hour on Nov 1. You will not be billed for duplicates.' Sending to the 41 workspace admins at 1 PM unless anyone objects.

author: priya
text: No objection. This also means nobody turns Atlas on for a customer until the dedupe and backfill land. Data correctness first.

author: wei
text: PR #221 (dedupe on event_id) merged and Nov 1 backfill re-run. Spot-checked Northwind: 1–2 AM hour now matches raw events.

author: lucas
text: Billing aggregates recomputed for all 41 workspaces. Totals match raw events. Unfreezing.

author: aisha
text: Closing INC-2291. Postmortem Monday Nov 9, Wei to draft. SUP-1180 resolved with Northwind.
